name: tpl-chain-response-1-nogoal-carry~p1
task: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up. If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task explicitly requires the agent to reach the exit, but the clauses contain no hard `Existence(at_exit)` to make the exit a goal. Add a hard `Existence(at_exit)` clause. Furthermore, the second clause uses `Response(box_fell, holding_box)`, which only forces the box to be held at some point after the fall. The task says "make your very next move the one that picks it back up," so the correct template is `ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)`. Replace the second clause accordingly. These changes will align the clauses with the task’s requirements.

texts: The agent must reach the exit.
If the agent reaches the exit, it must be holding the box.
If the box falls, the agent must be holding the box on the next step.
